# Abracadabra AI

> We design, build and run AI-powered tools that fit your business, not the other way around.

Abracadabra AI turns a description of how you already work into production software. AI takes a task; a person stays where the relationship matters. Contact houdini@abra-ca-dabra.app. Site https://abra-ca-dabra.app/. Last updated: 2026-10-23.

## What we build

Software follows the steps, exceptions, and words you already use. Eight functions (Search & AI visibility, Marketing, Social media, Sales, Customer service, Operations, Design, and Platform) start from one written plan so later work runs together. AEO, GEO, and SEO run as one discipline. MCP connectors on Cloudflare let assistants use your tools with sign-in, permissions, and approval before any change. Each project leaves you with the live system, the film, and the words to show it.

Wellness and clinical-style tools the studio builds are non-diagnostic: they educate and route; they do not diagnose.

## Proof: pirx.ca

From near-zero to 398K search impressions and 46.5K AI-feature impressions in 90 days for pirx.ca. Google Search Console, Jul 18 to Oct 17, 2026: 398K search impressions, 1.94K clicks, average position 7.6. The Generative AI features report is a separate count (46.5K impressions) and is not added to the search total. Top pages in that AI-features report: good-10k-time-by-age 11,068; good-half-marathon-time-by-age 8,192; good-5k-time-by-age 6,728. Both curves start near zero in mid-July, step up around Aug 31, and reach daily peaks of about 12–18K (search) and about 1.2–1.8K (AI features) by mid-September. Search impressions and AI-feature impressions are separate reports. These counts are indexed demand, not a traffic or revenue result.

## How a project works

1. You describe the work in your own words: the steps, the exceptions, and the sentence a good rep already says.
2. We build the software around those steps. AI removes a task. A person stays where the relationship matters.
3. You leave with the live system, the film, and the words.

When a product already on the market does the job, the reply says so and points there.

## Blog

- [AI Agents for Business: When to Use One](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/ai-agents-for-business): When an AI agent is worth it, when a simple workflow is the better buy, and why a person should still check the output.
- [AI Agents vs Agentic AI: A Plain Split](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/ai-agents-vs-agentic-ai): An agent takes a goal and chooses tools. Agentic AI is the wider bet, and many of those projects are forecast to be canceled. Start with a workflow.
- [AI Automation Agency vs Consultant: Who to Hire](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/ai-automation-agency-vs-consultant): Hire a consultant to name the job. Hire an agency to build after the job is named. Who to hire first, and why the order matters.
- [AI Automation for Small Business: Which Job First](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/ai-automation-for-small-business): Pick the first job by volume, how stable the rules are, whether the data can be read, and what a wrong answer costs. Surveys show which jobs already appear.
- [AI Consultant for Small Business: What to Ask](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/ai-consultant-for-small-business): A useful consultant names the job, the data, and the stop. Most firms use AI somewhere. Far fewer are scaling agents. Guaranteed rankings are a red flag.
- [AI for Small Business: What the Surveys Still Say](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/ai-for-small-business-2027): Two surveys still disagree because they ask different questions. One counts generative AI use. The other counts AI used to produce the goods or the service.
- [An AI Implementation Framework in Five Stages](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/ai-implementation-framework): Name the job, score the data, write the process, assign a checker, then keep or stop. Surveys show use is common and scaling is not.
- [AI Readiness Assessment Questionnaire: The Themes](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/ai-readiness-assessment-questionnaire): Ask about data, process, people, and the decision before you ask about a tool. A public checklist does not publish a readiness rate for small firms.
- [AI Readiness Assessment: What It Measures and How to Score](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/ai-readiness-assessment): An AI readiness assessment scores data, process, people, and decisions. Compare public tools, then read what each Readiness Check band means.
- [AI Readiness Checklist Before You Buy a Tool](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/ai-readiness-checklist): Questions to answer before you buy an AI tool, grouped by data, process, people, and the decision. Public surveys name the gaps those questions catch.
- [An AI Readiness Framework an Owner Can Score](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/ai-readiness-framework): Score data, process, people, and the decision in words, then read the band. Public research names the gaps. The check names the one that is yours.
- [AI-Ready Data: What a Small Business Needs First](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/ai-ready-data): AI-ready data means one current source for the job, readable by a system. Gartner's figures describe the firms that do not have that yet.
- [AI Strategy for Small Business: Start With the Job](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/ai-strategy-for-small-business): Name the job, the data, and who checks the output before you buy a tool. Use is already common. A written plan and staff training are not.
- [Answer Engine Optimization: What Google Still Requires](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/answer-engine-optimization): Google still treats answer-engine work as ordinary SEO. A research paper reports visibility gains. Pew found fewer clicks when a summary appears.
- [Business Process Automation With AI: Write the Job](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/business-process-automation-ai): Write the steps before you add a model. Most knowledge workers already use AI. Few companies were planning training. Many proofs of concept still stop.
- [Generative Engine Optimization vs SEO](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/generative-engine-optimization-vs-seo): Google says the new names are still SEO. A research paper measures visibility. Pew measured the click. Write the page so both can use it.
- [How Can AI Help a Small Business? What Surveys Count](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/how-can-ai-help-small-businesses): Two 2025 surveys count different work. This note separates generative-AI use from AI in production, then names the jobs owners hand over.
- [How Client Work Moves Through HQ and Our AI Agents](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/how-client-work-flows-through-hq): A request comes in, HQ files it, Grok Bot agents build it, Client Services checks it, and our team signs off before it lands in your own HQ space.
- [How to Show Up in ChatGPT and AI Overviews](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/how-to-get-your-business-to-show-up-in-chatgpt): Showing up in ChatGPT search is a crawler and indexing problem. Google still treats answer-engine advice as ordinary SEO. Clicks fall when a summary appears.
- [How to Use AI in Your Business: Twelve Jobs](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/how-to-use-ai-in-your-business): Pick a job you already do, write the steps, and keep a person on the output. A Canadian survey shows which uses, and which follow-on work, are common.
- [Is My Business Ready for AI? Signs to Read First](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/is-my-business-ready-for-ai): Ready means the data, the process, the people, and the decision can carry a tool. This note reads the Check bands against a large-firm index.
- [Off-the-Shelf AI or Custom Software](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/off-the-shelf-ai-or-custom-software): Buy the product when it already does the job. Build only when the job is yours alone. Surveys show generative AI use is already common among small firms.
- [What Is an AI Agent? A Plain Answer for Owners](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/what-is-an-ai-agent): An agent chooses a step from what it just found. A workflow follows a path you wrote. This note uses Anthropic's split and McKinsey's count of who is scaling.
- [What Is llms.txt, and Who Actually Reads It](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/what-is-llms-txt): A proposed file that points models at your best pages. Google says it does not use the file. A large study found most copies are never requested.
- [Why AI Pilots Stall After the Demo](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/why-ai-pilots-stall): Pilots stall when the data, the risk controls, or the value was never named. Surveys show use is common and scaling is rare. The demo is not the process.
- [Why We Build on Cloudflare: Security, AI and the Edge](https://abra-ca-dabra.app/blog/why-we-build-on-cloudflare): Our site, our Readiness Check and HQ all run on Cloudflare. Here is what the platform gives us for safety, AI tools, data and cost, with sources.
